title: Creamy Tuscan Chicken
instructions: Season chicken breasts with salt, pepper, and garlic powder.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and sear chicken for 5 minutes per side until golden.
Remove chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Pour heavy cream and chicken broth into the skillet; whisk in Parmesan cheese until smooth.
Stir in spinach and sun-dried tomatoes; simmer until spinach wilts.
Return chicken to the pan and spoon sauce over top before serving.
